notes: Reviewed exceptions for Tier A/B places without a validated station match, or with known grid/terrain semantics issues.
exceptionReason values: terrain | coastal-exposure | zone-vs-town | station-relocation | grid-limitation | station-mapping-pending | elevation-mismatch | authored-blend-divergence.
Large authored-vs-Daymet deltas are a review queue, not automatic proof either value is wrong. Daymet V2 remains the runtime source of truth once overlaid.

hood-river-gorge.notes: Columbia Gorge gap corridor: Daymet 1 km pixel elevation +343 m vs authored river-level reference. Climate-anchor override documents zone-floor semantics; do not retune lat/lon merely to shrink grid delta.

redfield-ny.notes: Tug Hill Plateau: Daymet grid elevation −252 m vs authored plateau elevation; lake-effect snow is station-sourced separately from Daymet SWE. Authored precip also diverges (~30%).

hood-river-or.notes: Orchard-belt / valley-floor semantics vs Daymet pixel; pending GHCN station mapping.

honolulu-hi.notes: Island coastal pixel vs authored urban normals; precipitation bias >100% vs authored. Daymet land pixel retained; official station validation pending.

mount-charleston-nv.notes: Sky-island / steep terrain: winter lows and precip diverge from authored town normals (>2°C low, >30% precip).

lone-pine-ca.notes: Owens Valley floor vs Sierra-adjacent pixel effects; winter low and precip outliers vs authored.

real-catorce-mx.notes: High desert pueblo: authored Tier C blend vs Daymet 1 km (~4°C summer high, ~34% precip). Mexico SMN station validation pending; Daymet retained as cross-border truth.

ensenada-mx.notes: Pacific coastal Baja: authored vs Daymet diverge on both temperature (~5°C high) and precip (~32%). Coastal marine influence / land-mask effects under review.

iqaluit-nu.notes: Arctic coastal settlement: winter lows diverge ~5°C from authored. Daymet northern edge / coastal ice regime; ECCC station validation pending.

prince-rupert-bc.notes: Hyper-maritime North Coast: retained for priority review even when within numeric thresholds; coastal exposure and station mapping pending.

santa-barbara-ca.notes: South Coast marine layer / foothill semantics: summer highs ~3.4°C warmer in Daymet than authored coastal normals.

mexico-grid-queue.notes: Many Mexico places show authored-vs-Daymet temperature outliers because prior corpus used editorial blends. Daymet is the cross-border source; SMN/WMO station mapping is a follow-up program, not a silent replace.
